chunks: God had chosen Adam and Noah and the families of Abraham and 'Imran in preference to others.
ai.seo_question: Who did God choose above all the worlds according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing the hierarchy of divine election, with the 'Family of Imran' specifically linked to the Prophet Muhammad and his Ahl al-Bayt, signifying their spiritual and temporal superiority. The selection underscores a continuous lineage of purity and guidance, reinforcing the concept of *Ismah* (infallibility) within these chosen families.
